ko: 기쁘다 구주 오셨네 만 백성 맞으라
en: Joy to the world! The Lord is come Let earth receive her King Let every heart prepare Him room
heaven and nature sing, And heaven and heaven and nature sing
Joy to the earth! The Savior reigns Let men their songs employ While fields and floods, rocks, hills, and plains
Repeat the sounding joy, Repeat, repeat the sounding joy

ko: 온 세상 죄를 사하려 주 예수 오셨네
en: No more let sins and sorrows grow, Nor thorns in-fest the ground He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found, Far as, far as the curse is found.
He rules the world with truth and grace, And makes the nations prove The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love, And wonders, wonders of His love
